notes.title: Thank you for the support of the game ! [info about the future]
notes.notes:
First of all, the whole team thanks you so much for supporting Blood Spear, whether it is the streams, the videos, the reviews or just playing the game, it means a lot for us as new developers in the industry.

We had a lot of fun developing this project we’re more than happy that you enjoyed it.


We want to address a subject that comes up often “Will there be a full game/sequel?”

As some of you may know, Blood Spear was our graduation project, as newcomers in the industry we are currently looking for more experience in different companies, the team will split up for the moment. 

However, in the future the team wishes to work together again, whether on Blood Spear or new projects.

Thanks to all the players,

                     The Blood Spear dev team
